title: 第16章 初恋第17章 吃夜宵
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
很快的功夫，包房的门就被敲响了，然后门被推开了一群人走了进来。
为首的一是一个寸头，穿着范思哲衣服，右手手腕上戴着江诗丹顿手表的青年，他明显就是那个什么古武家族嫡子王少王杰了。
王杰的身边还有一个女人，这个女孩子大概20多岁的样子，长的是十分的好看，她皮肤细腻眼睛大而明亮，眼睫毛浓密狭长和蝴蝶翅膀一样，她的长相能打八分。
她的穿戴也十分的性感讲究，一身黑色连衣礼裙搭配肉色丝袜，整个人显得很高贵。
不过她脸上的表情十分冰冷，似乎不怎么高兴，她明显就是王少的未婚妻。
“王少，林妹子快坐。”
此刻，李聪聪则连忙为王杰拉开了椅子，让王少和他未婚妻坐下。
只是谁也没注意到陈锋已经是脸色大变了，他的目光死死的盯着王少的这个未婚妻。
“仙儿，是你吗？真的是你，我没看错？”
陈锋忽然开口询问道，他的声音带着一丝颤抖。
陈锋自从一月前下山以来问过很多朋友和同学，他四处打听初恋女友林仙儿的下落，可惜没有人知道，本来陈锋也是放弃了，不过他万万没想到在今晚看到了林仙儿。
虽然十年没见了，不过到底是自己的初恋女友，陈锋怎么会认错了。，
相比以前，如今的林仙儿可谓是成熟了许多，也漂亮的许多，她是那么的熟悉。
“陈锋？”
林仙儿也看到了陈锋，她很是惊讶，不过很快的功夫她似乎想到了什么，忙将头别到了一边。
不过她虽然背过了头，不过身体明显在颤抖。
“什么情况？”
“啥子情况？”
……
此刻，李聪聪和欧阳锋都惊呆了，都看着陈锋，感情陈锋认识王少的未婚妻吗。

至于王杰，他也是脸色大变，他看了看李聪聪询问：“他是谁？”
这个他自然是指陈锋了。
“王少，他就是我和你说的陈大师，很厉害的大师，他好几次救了我的性命的，那两头蛇妖都是陈大师消灭的。”
李聪聪忙说道。
王杰是古武家族的嫡子，李聪聪虽然厉害，不过李家和古武家族王家比起来还差一些，虽然他对王少是很恭敬的，他不敢得罪王少。
不过李聪聪似乎很好奇，为什么陈大师认识王少的未婚妻了。
“哦，不过是一个修法大师而已，我们王家多是这种武者，对了仙儿，你认识他吗？”
王杰点了点头，目光看向了身边的未婚妻林仙儿，要知道王杰是王家嫡子，林仙儿是林家嫡女，他们属于豪门联姻，而且下个月国庆就要结婚了，王杰可不希望搞出什么幺蛾子来。
而且王杰感觉眼前的陈锋看自己未婚妻的眼神不对，怎么好像是看自己的爱人一样，一时间王杰感觉头上绿油油的，所以他则询问未婚妻。
“我……不认识他。”
林仙儿犹豫了一下，还是脱口而出，不过她不敢看陈锋。
“仙儿，你说什么？你干嘛不认我？”
陈锋激动的不行，直接起过来握住了林仙儿的手，他确定这个女孩子就是初恋女友林仙儿，两人当年都谈了大半年恋爱，而且还偷吃了禁果，但是为什么现在仙儿不愿意认他了。
“先生，你认错人了吧，我不认识你，请你离开。”
林仙儿吓得不行，她直接推开了陈锋，明亮的眸子里更是流下眼泪来，她哭了。
content_en:
Soon, there was a knock on the private room door, and then the door was pushed open and a group of people came in.
The leader was a young man with short hair, wearing Versace clothes, and a Vacheron Constantin watch on his right wrist. He was obviously Wang Shao Wangjie, the legitimate son of the Guwu family.
There is a woman next to Wang Jie. This girl is probably in her 20s. She is very good-looking. Her skin is delicate and her eyes are big and bright. Her eyelashes are as thick and long as butterfly wings. Her appearance can be rated eight points.
She is also very sexy and elegant in her dress. She wears a black dress with flesh-colored stockings, making her look very noble.
However, the expression on her face was very cold and she seemed unhappy. She was obviously Mr. Wang's fiancée.
"Master Wang, sister Lin, sit down quickly."
At this moment, Li Congcong quickly pulled out a chair for Wang Jie and asked Wang Shao and his fiancée to sit down.
But no one noticed that Chen Feng's expression had changed drastically, and his eyes were fixed on Mr. Wang's fiancée.
"Xian'er, is it you? It's really you, am I right?"
Chen Feng suddenly asked, his voice trembling.
Chen Feng has asked many friends and classmates since he came down from the mountain a month ago. He asked everywhere about the whereabouts of his first girlfriend, Lin Xian'er. Unfortunately, no one knew. Chen Feng originally gave up, but he never expected to see Lin Xian'er tonight.
Although they haven't seen each other for ten years, she is still his first girlfriend. How could Chen Feng admit his mistake. ,
Compared with before, Lin Xian'er today is much more mature and beautiful. She is so familiar.
"Chen Feng?"
Lin Xian'er also saw Chen Feng. She was very surprised, but soon she seemed to have thought of something and quickly turned her head away.
But even though she turned her head away, her body was obviously shaking.
"What's going on?"
"What's going on?"
…
At this moment, Li Congcong and Ouyang Feng were both stunned and looked at Chen Feng, wondering if Chen Feng knew Mr. Wang's fiancée.
As for Wang Jie, his expression also changed drastically. He looked at Li Congcong and asked, "Who is he?"
Naturally, he was referring to Chen Feng.
"Master Wang, he is the Master Chen I told you, a very powerful master. He saved my life several times. The two snake demons were destroyed by Master Chen."
Li Congcong said hurriedly.
Wang Jie is the direct son of the Guwu family. Although Li Congcong is powerful, the Li family is still inferior to the Wang family of the Guwu family. Although he is very respectful to Young Master Wang, he does not dare to offend Young Master Wang.
However, Li Congcong seemed to be curious as to why Master Chen knew Mr. Wang's fiancée.
"Oh, he's just a master of cultivation. Most of our Wang family are such warriors. By the way, Xian'er, do you know him?"
Wang Jie nodded and looked at his fiancée Lin Xian'er beside him. You must know that Wang Jie is the legitimate son of the Wang family and Lin Xian'er is the legitimate daughter of the Lin family. They belong to a wealthy marriage and are getting married on National Day next month. Wang Jie doesn't want to cause any trouble.
Moreover, Wang Jie felt that Chen Feng in front of him was looking at his fiancée in the wrong way. He seemed to be looking at his lover. For a moment, Wang Jie felt that his head was green, so he asked his fiancée.
"I... don't know him."
Lin Xian'er hesitated for a moment and blurted out, but she didn't dare to look at Chen Feng.
"Xian'er, what did you say? Why don't you recognize me?"
Chen Feng was so excited that he stood up and held Lin Xian'er's hand. He was sure that this girl was his first girlfriend Lin Xian'er. They had been in love for more than half a year and even ate the forbidden fruit secretly, but why did Xian'er not want to recognize him now?
"Sir, you have mistaken the person. I don't know you. Please leave."
Lin Xian'er was so frightened that she pushed Chen Feng away directly, tears streaming down her bright eyes, and she cried.
